units.title: Introduction & Linked Lists
units.topics: ADT, data types, static vs dynamic memory, singly / doubly / circular lists, polynomials, sparse matrices, Josephus, loop detection

units.title: Stacks
units.topics: Stack ADT, array & linked stacks, infix / postfix / prefix conversion and evaluation, parenthesis balancing, recursion, Tower of Hanoi

units.topics: Simple, circular, deque and priority queues, array & linked implementations, multiple queues, scheduling, ring buffers, Josephus, BFS

units.title: Heaps, Advanced Trees, Graphs & Hashing

changelog.text: Units 3–5 rebuilt for the new syllabus: Queues is now Unit 3, Trees is Unit 4 (threaded trees moved in), Heaps merged into Unit 5 with B-trees, BFS/DFS and graph applications added.
Lab programs added: Josephus, loop detection, polynomial subtraction, sparse matrix multiplication (Unit 1); prefix evaluation and iterative Tower of Hanoi (Unit 2).
Corrected: threaded-tree thread lists, a max-heap insertion figure, the standard vs compressed trie figure, and the B+ tree construction trace.
Units 1–2 re-aligned to the new syllabus (linked lists moved to Unit 1, stacks to Unit 2).
